name: TwoByteEsc
comment: Intel 80286 two-byte-escape opcodes — entered when BlockDetector
sees byte 0x0F. The SECOND byte is the dispatch key for this set.
Mask/match are against that second byte (i.e. 0xFF mask, 0x06 match
Sprint 26.2b — initial entry list contains only CLTS as a smoke
test for the 0F-prefix decoder dispatch path. Sprint 26.3 will add
the LGDT/LIDT/LMSW/SMSW group, and Sprint 26.4 will wire them to
real implementations against the MSW + GDTR/IDTR state registers.

encoding_groups.name: Clts
encoding_groups.comment: 0F 06 CLTS — clear MSW.TS bit. Sprint 26.2b: stub no-op (advances IP only). Sprint 26.4 wires the real MSW.TS clear.

formats.name: ZeroOneGroup286
formats.comment: 0F 01 group — ModR/M.reg selects SGDT(0)/SIDT(1)/LGDT(2)/LIDT(3)/SMSW(4)/[5 reserved]/LMSW(6)/[7 INVLPG/386+]. Phase 26 v1: dispatcher emitter routes only /4 SMSW; others throw NotImplementedException. The dispatch happens at RUNTIME inside the emitter (matching the F6/F7 group pattern in 8086 base spec) since modrm_reg is part of the ModR/M byte that comes AFTER the dispatch word — selector-based static dispatch wouldn't see it.
